mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PermissionRule decouples Operation.outcome from IsPermitted. The injection then asks Alloy to find a Permitted Operation whose (role, opKind) cell (ComplianceOfficer, ReadRecord) is explicitly denied by the matrix — a direct counterexample to LeastPrivilege and the compliance-content-forbidden assertions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some o: Operation | o.outcome = Permitted and o.actor.role = ComplianceOfficer and o.opKind = ReadRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the one-audit-per-operation constraint. The injection forces an Operation that has no associated AuditEntry, directly contradicting the audit-completeness assertions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some o: Operation | no a: AuditEntry | a.op = o }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the attribution fact lets the AuditEntry's accessor field drift from the underlying Operation's actor. The injection forces such a misattributed audit entry into the instance.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some a: AuditEntry | a.accessor != a.op.actor }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_NoteOpLink is the bijection between ClinicalNote and permitted-append Operations. Clearing it lets a 'phantom' note exist with no creating operation — exactly the append-only / provenance violation the AppendOnly assertion is meant to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | no o: Operation | o.createdNote = n }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission rule severs the link between Permitted outcomes and the care-team membership precondition. The injection forces a clinician to be granted a Permitted ReadRecord on a record they are NOT on the care team for — the canonical ownership/care-team violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some o: Operation | o.outcome = Permitted and o.actor.role = Clinician and o.opKind = ReadRecord and (o.actor -> o.target) not in CareTeam.members }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_NoteOpLink decouples a Denied operation from its (forbidden) side effects. The injection forces a Denied operation that nonetheless produced a clinical note — a state change leaking through the byte-equivalent 403 envelope.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakageViolation { some o: Operation | o.outcome = Denied and some o.createdNote }
